board: Sensirion SFA30-D-T formaldehyde module (e.g. SEK-SFA30 kit), Molex 7-pin connector wired out with jumper leads, I2C mode
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring with 10 kOhm pull-ups, design checks, breadboard, simulator, PCB, footprint). The read-measured-values command 0x0327 is modelled as 3 signed int16 words, each followed by a Sensirion CRC (HCHO/5 ppb, RH/100 %, T/200 C), as in the Sensirion SFA30 I2C interface note.
breakoutPinoutSource: SFA30 datasheet V1.1 section 2.5, Table 8 (connector pins 1-7: VDD, GND, SDA/RX, SCL/TX, SEL, NC, NC); I2C details from https://sensirion.com/en/media/documents/974A16B3/634D0684/Sensirion_Formaldehyde_Sensor_I2C_Interface.pdf
